title: GTA 6 Original Soundtrack Revealed with 34 Tracks
description: GTA 6 original soundtrack partially revealed by Eurogamer, featuring 34 original tracks and real-world artists, with six tracks available to stream now.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## GTA 6 Original Soundtrack Details Partially Revealed

Music has always been the beating heart of the *Grand Theft Auto* franchise. As anticipation reaches a fever pitch for Rockstar Games' upcoming open-world crime epic, fresh details regarding the game's audio landscape have emerged. According to a recent report by gaming media outlet Eurogamer, the original soundtrack for *Grand Theft Auto 6* has been partially revealed, giving fans a glimpse into the auditory experience awaiting them.

### A Massive Lineup of Original Music

The full album for *Grand Theft Auto 6* is slated to contain **34 original tracks**. These songs have been custom-crafted specifically for the upcoming open-world crime game, featuring contributions from multiple real-world artists. Given Rockstar Games' history of curating iconic radio stations and immersive scores that define generations of gaming, the inclusion of 34 dedicated original tracks suggests a massive and deeply atmospheric sonic landscape.

### Stream Six Tracks Today

Fans do not have to wait until the game's release to experience a taste of the new music. Alongside the partial reveal, it was announced that **six tracks** from the upcoming soundtrack are available to stream today. This allows players and music enthusiasts alike to dive straight into the soundscape of the next-generation title and sample the direction the developers are taking with the game's audio design.

While further details about the full tracklist and the complete roster of participating artists remain under wraps, this initial music drop provides plenty of material for the community to analyze while waiting for further updates.

## Editor's Take

Music is a defining pillar of the *GTA* experience. Revealing a 34-song original soundtrack with real-world artists—and dropping six tracks early for streaming—is a brilliant marketing and community move. It builds immersive hype and proves that Rockstar is once again paying meticulous attention to every detail of the world they are building.
